name: defensive_cyclical_switch_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: Indian market intraday rotation between defensive sectors (FMCG, Pharma, IT) and cyclical sectors (Auto, Metal, Realty, Infra) is predicted by changes in India VIX within the session. When VIX rises >0.5 points intraday, money flows from cyclicals to defensives within 15-30 minutes. When VIX falls >0.5 points, the reverse occurs. This pattern exists because: (1) institutional risk management systems adjust sector exposure based on real-time VIX, (2) Indian mutual fund managers use VIX as a tactical allocation signal, (3) the flow from cyclicals to defensives is slower than the VIX move itself, creating a tradeable lag. Unlike daily-frequency rotation strategies, intraday VIX changes are mean-reverting (VIX itself mean-reverts intraday), providing natural profit-taking opportunities.
universe: Defensives: NIFTY FMCG, NIFTY Pharma, NIFTY IT. Cyclicals: NIFTY Auto, NIFTY Metal, NIFTY Realty, NIFTY Infra
stock_filter: Top 2 by ADV in each sector, ADV > ₹20 crore, total 14 stocks

indicators.name: vix_regime
indicators.formula: 'risk_off' if vix_change_30min > 0.5 else ('risk_on' if vix_change_30min < -0.5 else 'neutral')

conditions: vix_regime == 'risk_off' AND dc_spread < 0 (VIX rising but cyclicals still outperforming — rotation hasn't happened yet)
long.confirmation: dc_spread starts turning positive (defensives beginning to outperform)

conditions: vix_regime == 'risk_on' AND dc_spread > 0 (VIX falling but defensives still outperforming — rotation hasn't happened yet)
short.confirmation: dc_spread starts turning negative (cyclicals beginning to outperform)

entry.entry_price: market order: long defensive basket + short cyclical basket (risk_off) or vice versa

exit.target: dc_spread moves 20 bps in expected direction (rotation complete)
exit.stop_loss: dc_spread moves 15 bps against position (rotation not happening)
exit.trailing_stop: 8 bps trailing after 12 bps profit on spread

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX absolute level > 12 (in very low VIX, changes are too small to drive rotation)
filters.time_filter: no trades before 10:00 (VIX needs time to establish direction) or after 14:30
filters.volume_filter: all basket stocks trading at > 0.7x normal volume
filters.trend_filter: skip if NIFTY 50 is moving > 1.5% intraday (macro overwhelms rotation)
filters.event_filter: skip on budget day, RBI day (VIX changes are one-directional, not mean-reverting)
other_filters: skip if fewer than 5 of the 14 stocks are actively traded

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low — defensive/cyclical rotation is a permanent feature of equity markets driven by institutional risk management frameworks. The intraday timing component adds alpha over well-known daily-frequency rotation.

weaknesses: Trading 4-8 stocks simultaneously (basket approach) is operationally complex with Zerodha's API limits and increases total transaction costs.
India VIX 1-min data can be noisy (computed from NIFTY option chain every 15 sec). A 0.5-point change may be noise, not signal.
On trend days (strong VIX expansion), the rotation happens once and doesn't revert. The strategy assumes mean-reverting VIX, which fails on tail days.
prior_art: Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen (2013) 'Value and Momentum Everywhere' — factor rotation literature. Mohanram (2005) on defensive vs cyclical characteristics. In India, Amundi-ACPI studies VIX-based sector allocation for Indian mutual funds.
notes: The VIX threshold of 0.5 points change is calibrated to India VIX typical daily range of 1-3 points. If VIX regime is persistently 'neutral', no trades are generated — this is by design. The strategy naturally avoids low-conviction days.
